preservation_scope: All tracked .lean files except import root lean/DefiKernel.lean, plus tracked corpus paths and corpus-named artifacts; baseline content hashes, not proof claims. Import root is separately recorded as an allowed composition integration edit.

runs.label: build
runs.scope: Full configured Lake target build; cached jobs replayed; runtime and axiom drivers also separately executed fresh.

record.scope: Records the verified push of complete source and acceptance evidence. A subsequent documentation-only commit records this result; its remote head is checked separately by the harness.

validation: All six exits zero; full-build job count nonzero; runtime names distinct with nonzero all-true comparisons; theorem and supplemental observed disclosure counts equal nonzero passing denominators and forbidden=0.
tracked_baseline_scope: Full tracked file inventory additionally recorded before composition edits, allowing final acceptance to identify all intentionally changed preexisting files.
